author: anotherali
quote: 13 years for this? Locking it to 30fps (and drops to 15fps sometimes) is unacceptable, the trailers were a lie and the graphics look worse. alot of bugs and glitches , the new car-stealing and building the house minigames are complete ****, and the roads are way too tight. Story drags on forever with nothing new or innovative, just stuffed with NSFW scenes. Even Muting licensed music for streaming leaves the game totally silent with nothing to replace it. 80$ is WAY too expensive and overrated for what you actually get.
